features.title: Create a chat design ui only with nativetailwind
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can click New Chat and see a fresh empty conversation.
verification: Open the app.
Click New Chat.
Verify a new conversation appears in the sidebar.
Verify the main panel shows an empty conversation state.
evidence: web export and runtime verified — chat list and chat screen both render
iOS export and simulator verified — both screens render correctly
features.notes: UI-only implementation with in-memory state via React context. Conversation list at / with + New Chat button; chat screen at /chat/[id] with empty state and disabled input.

features.title: Send a message in the current conversation
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can submit a message and see it appear in the active thread.
verification: Open an existing conversation.
Type a message into the input.
Submit the message.
Verify the new message appears in the thread.
evidence: iOS export and simulator verified — chat screen renders with editable input and Send button
features.notes: User messages stored in ChatContext. Input wired to sendMessage which appends to messages array and updates conversation title. Messages render as right-aligned blue bubbles in a FlatList with auto-scroll.

features.title: Stream LLM response to the ui
features.user_visible_behavior: User should see the llm response coming in stream
verification: LLM responses should be streamed
User should see messages coming in stream
evidence: needs manual test: send a message and verify response streams in progressively
features.notes: API route forwards SSE stream from OpenAI. Chat context reads stream with ReadableStream reader, parses SSE events, and updates assistant message text progressively. Empty assistant bubble appears immediately on send.

features.title: Update the chat UI, to replace send with a stop button
features.user_visible_behavior: User should see stop button instead of send when llm repsonse stream is not finished
verification: User sends a message
LLM response is streamed
User sees stop button instead of send
After, the llm response streaming is complete, restores send button hiding stop button
evidence: needs manual test: verify stop button appears during streaming and reverts to send after
features.notes: Send button swaps to red Stop button when isStreaming is true. Reverts when streaming completes or is aborted.

features.title: Stop LLM response when stop button is clicked
features.user_visible_behavior: User should be able to stop the llm response
verification: User sends a message
LLM response is streaming
User clicks stop button
llm streaming is stopped and chat ui is restored
evidence: needs manual test: verify stop button aborts the stream and restores send button
features.notes: AbortController stored in ref. stopStreaming aborts the fetch and resets isStreaming. Partial text from the stream is preserved in the message.

features.title: Remove LLM chat bubble from UI if the message is empty and isStreaming is false
features.user_visible_behavior: User should not see empty llm empty chat bubble when he aborts the request
verification: User sends a message
LLM response is streaming
User clicks stop button
User should not see empty chat bubble
evidence: needs manual test: send a message, abort before content arrives, verify empty bubble is removed
features.notes: In sendMessage finally block, filter out the assistant message if its text is still empty. Handles abort-before-content and stream-ends-without-content cases. Messages with partial content are preserved.
